title: Bitcoin hit $60,000 because two different groups finally surrendered — on-chain data shows who blinked
summary: Bitcoin’s February drop to about $60,000 was the kind of single-day panic people will remember as a bottom. But the more accurate reading of this washout is harder and more useful: this cycle quit in stages, and the sellers rotated.
